title: A review on the role of deep eutectic solvents in mango (Mangifera indica) extraction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4296-4321
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00097A, Review Article
Open Access

Ahmad Mukhlis Abdul Rahman, Amirul Ridzuan Abu Bakar, Ang Qian Yee, Mohd Asraf Mohd Zainudin, Nik Muhammad Azhar Nik Daud, Ahmad Anas Nagoor Gunny, Mohd Sharizan Md Sarip, Ryan Vitthaya Peron, Nurul Husna Khairuddin
The present review attempts to evaluate the applicability of deep eutectic solvents (DES) as a green technique for the extraction of phytochemicals from Mangifera indica L. and their therapeutic potential.
